declarations.name: AuiFormField
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI Form Field around a projected native control:
`<aui-form-field label="ZIP"><input formControlName="zip" required></aui-form-field>`.
The native control keeps Angular's own value accessor; AbsoluteUI adds the label,
help text, and localized validation messages.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Visible label and accessible name (<label for> the control).

inputs.name: hideLabel
inputs.description: Visually hide the label; it remains the accessible name.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: Sets the native required property and the indicator. When omitted, the control's own required attribute is used.

inputs.name: validate
inputs.description: Consumer validation after native constraints; return a message to mark the value invalid. string[] for <select multiple>.

inputs.name: validationTiming
inputs.description: When validation messages first appear; afterwards they update live.

outputs.name: valueInput
outputs.description: Native input event on the control.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: Native change event on the control.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now; true when valid.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error (server, cross-field rule); cleared when the user edits.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Re-read the control's constraints after changing them outside AbsoluteUI.

accessibility.pattern: Native form control with a <label for> association (HTML); the consumer's element keeps its native role.

limitations: Constraint attributes are read on each render; after changing attributes or the value in code, call refresh().
The initial value for dirty and reset() is captured at creation.
No character counter; use Text Input or Textarea for that.
